text:
The evidence confirms a 25.5 ha tree-cover loss event in 2015 (Hansen GFC, status "supported"), but it does not say why it happened. It only detects when and how much stand-replacing loss occurred. It gives no cause, such as clearing, harvest, fire or storm, and no land-use information.

The 2015 event is historical, before the 2020-12-31 baseline, so it falls outside the evaluated claim. For 2021-2025, no loss event of 0.5 ha or more was detected. Only 0.4 ha of sub-threshold loss appeared, in 2021.

One point to check: the dataset reports only 23 ha of tree cover in 2000, yet the pre-baseline loss events total about 98.8 ha. This discrepancy may reflect differences in thresholds or data, and it deserves review before relying on the figures.

To find the cause, you would need imagery review, management records or local knowledge.
